'''''Star Wars: Starfighter: The Rock Pirate of Kaneen''''' is an upcoming [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries that will serve as a prequel to the film ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter]]''. The series will be written by [[Marc Guggenheim]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[2027]].<ref name="SW.com" />
